title: Why Advice Doesn't Stick (It's Not Willpower)
description:
The reason advice doesn't stick isn't willpower. It's timing.
You can't absorb a lesson before you've lived what it's pointing at.
#Shorts #selfimprovement #personalgrowth #mindset
hook_visual: Close-up on a phone screen showing a bookmarks folder overflowing with saved self-improvement articles — text overlay fades in within 2 seconds: 'You already knew this.' Cut to face reacting.
end_screen_cta: Look directly at camera and ask: 'Which piece of advice are you still waiting to live your way into?' Hold for two seconds, then subscribe prompt overlays.
